samples.reply: Nina furaha kukusaidia kujisajili! Je, unajiandikisha ukiwa mtu binafsi au shirika (kampuni, shirika lisilo la kiserikali, ushirika)?

Enkola ya Electronic Fiscal Receipting and Invoicing System (EFRIS) nkola ey'okukozesa kompyuta okufulumya lisiiti n'ebiwandiiko ebirala mu bizinensi. Buli bizinensi erina okukozesa enkola eno singa eba ewandiisiddwa mu mateeka ga musolo. Enkola eno ekakasa obwerufu n'obutuufu bw'emisolo egisasulibwa.

---

Kuwasilisha marejesho ya kodi ya mwaka ni muhimu sana! Hapa kuna hatua za msingi unazopaswa kufuata:

1. **Tayarisha Marejesho yako**: Kwanza, hakikisha unaandaa nyaraka zote zinazohusiana na mapato yako ya mwaka. Hii inaweza kutia ndani nakala za risiti, taarifa za malipo, na hesabu za kodi ulizolipa katika kipindi hicho.

2. **Pakua Fomu za Marejesho**: Unaweza kupakua fomu za marejesho za kodi

Okuwaayo alipoota y'omusolo eya buli mwaka, genda ku mukutu gwa URA ogwa [www.ura.go.ug](https://www.ura.go.ug) oba kozesa app ya URA M-PESA. Jjuza foomu y'omusolo ng'okozesa ebikwata ku bizineesi yo, oteekemu omuwendo gw'ensimbi z'olina okusasula, era osindike alipoota ku URA. Kino osobola okukikola mu bbanga lya myezi 3 nga tonnaba kuggwaako musolo.

---

To file your annual tax return:

1. Login ura.go.ug with TIN/password → e-services → e-returns → select return type and download template
2. Enable macros, fill without renaming or copy/paste
3. Validate to generate upload file
4. Back to e-returns upload file with return period and captcha
5. Submit
6. E-acknowledgment is issued (also emailed/portal)

**Due date:** A tax return is a declaration i
You deserve a definitive answer on this, so I've flagged it for a URA officer to review (ticket ac96bce9) — meanwhile, you can also reach URA directly at https://ura.go.ug or via the Contact Centre.
